name: static-portal-site
description: Static landing page with a procedural portal background

scripts.check: node --check public/js/main.js && node --check public/js/motion-preference.js && node --check public/js/portal-camera.js && node --check public/js/portal-drag.js && node --check public/js/portal-layers.js && node --check public/js/portal-motion.js && node --check public/js/portal-pattern.js && node --check public/js/portal-renderer.js && node --check public/js/portal-uniforms.js && node --check public/js/render-size.js
scripts.preview: docker build -t static-portal-site:preview . && docker run --rm --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges -p 8080:8080 static-portal-site:preview
